description: Stand up the full gabMileage Aspire solution (AppHost, ServiceDefaults, Api, Gateway, Web, test projects) and implement the WorkOS authentication flow at the YARP Gateway so users can sign in/out, establish a cookie-based session, and land on an inviting empty-garage dashboard with consistent loading/error states.

tasks.title: Scaffold Aspire solution structure
tasks.description: Create the solution structure described in the PRD: gabMileage.AppHost, gabMileage.ServiceDefaults, gabMileage.Api (ASP.NET Core + Marten + Wolverine), gabMileage.Gateway (YARP), gabMileage.Web (TanStack Start), and test projects under tests/. Wire Aspire local orchestration so a developer can run the AppHost and see all resources (Gateway, Api, Web, Postgres, Redis) start with health checks. Establish NodaTime usage conventions: Instant for timestamps, LocalDate for user-facing dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Solution builds locally and AppHost runs with Api, Gateway, Web, Postgres and Redis resources healthy
Api references Marten + Wolverine packages and is configured to use NodaTime types (Instant/LocalDate)
Gateway is configured as YARP reverse proxy routing Web→Gateway→Api

tasks.title: ServiceDefaults observability + health checks
tasks.description: Implement gabMileage.ServiceDefaults and apply it to Api and Gateway: OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logging defaults, and health checks surfaced in Aspire. Ensure all services expose health endpoints and that Aspire shows them.
acceptanceCriteria: Api and Gateway include ServiceDefaults and expose health checks
OpenTelemetry tracing is enabled and visible in Aspire for requests through Gateway
No service starts without passing its basic health check

tasks.title: Marten baseline + UserProvisioned event + UserProfile read model
tasks.description: Configure MartenDB with PostgreSQL as the event store. Add the domain event `UserProvisioned { userId, displayName, email, avatarUrl, occurredAt }` and a read model `UserProfile` persisted via a Marten projection. This projection is written/updated during first-login provisioning (performed by the Gateway after successful auth).
acceptanceCriteria: Event store schema is created/migrated on startup in dev
UserProvisioned event is persisted for first login
UserProfile read model can be queried by userId and includes displayName/email/avatarUrl/createdAt

tasks.title: Gateway WorkOS auth flow (login/callback/logout)
tasks.description: Implement the authentication flow in gabMileage.Gateway per Sprint 01 brief: `GET /api/auth/login` redirects (302) to WorkOS hosted auth, WorkOS callback exchanges authorization code for a JWT, validates it, and sets an HTTP-only secure SameSite=Lax cookie named `gab_session`. Implement transparent refresh-before-expiry on requests; if refresh fails or token invalid, treat as unauthenticated. Implement `POST /api/auth/logout` to clear the cookie and redirect to login. Also implement deep-link return: if user hits a protected URL while unauthenticated, after login they return to the original URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated requests to protected app routes end up at the login screen and preserve a return URL
After successful WorkOS login, Gateway sets `gab_session` as HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax cookie
`POST /api/auth/logout` clears the cookie and subsequent API calls return 401
Any API request with an invalid/expired session results in a redirect-to-login behavior (frontend)

tasks.title: Api auth context + authorization boundary
tasks.description: Ensure the Api has a consistent way to access authenticated `userId` (AuthContext) forwarded from the Gateway. Establish a baseline authorization policy so all garage data is scoped to `userId`. Even before vehicles exist, ensure the `GarageSummary` endpoint returns data only for the current user.
acceptanceCriteria: Api request handlers can access an AuthContext containing userId
All garage-facing endpoints are protected (401 when unauthenticated)
Cross-user access attempts are rejected without leaking existence (default to 404 semantics for user-owned resources)

tasks.title: Frontend auth shell + login + empty garage UX
tasks.description: In gabMileage.Web (TanStack Start), implement: (1) a login page with a single "Sign in" button that initiates the WorkOS flow via the Gateway, (2) an authenticated navigation shell (top bar with wordmark left, avatar+name right), (3) an auth-redirect loading screen ("Signing you in…"), and (4) the empty garage dashboard state with warm illustration, heading, subtext, and "+ Add Vehicle" CTA (route can be placeholder until Sprint 02). Implement loading skeletons and error states per brief: do not flash empty vs populated state.
acceptanceCriteria: When not signed in, visiting the app shows the login screen with a single "Sign in" button
After sign-in, user lands on the dashboard and sees the empty garage state when no vehicles exist
Global top bar appears on all authenticated pages and includes user dropdown with "Sign out"
Dashboard load uses skeleton state and never flashes the wrong empty/populated state

tasks.title: E2E smoke: login and empty garage
tasks.description: Add a Playwright E2E smoke test that exercises: unauthenticated → login screen, perform login via the configured WorkOS test tenant (or mocked/dev auth flow if the repo uses one), land on dashboard, and assert the empty garage state renders. Keep it minimal and stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright test suite includes a smoke test that covers login → dashboard
Smoke test asserts empty garage heading + CTA renders for a new user
Test can run locally using the existing Aspire orchestration/dev configuration
